snapshot_auto.quote: Our VM's automatically hibernate after 30 minutes of inactivity, but with our proprietary snapshotting technology, we are able to wake up our VM's so the response delay is less than a few seconds.
snapshot_auto.note: Environments go Running -> Stopped 'After 3 minutes of inactivity if there are builds queued' or 'After 60 minutes in general' (docs.webapp.io/snapshots) and restart from the VM snapshot. Snapshots are also taken automatically after each Layerfile step. Memory is included: 'Running processes are snapshotted and reused' (tuning-performance/the-layerfile-cache). Unclear whether runtime changes made after the build are captured at hibernation or whether wake restores the build-time snapshot.

snapshot_on_demand.quote: The `CHECKPOINT` instruction allows you to control exactly when webapp.io will take snapshots of the pipeline.
snapshot_on_demand.note: Snapshot points are declared in the Layerfile (build-time), not taken ad hoc on an arbitrary running VM; 'CHECKPOINT deploy' creates a named checkpoint 'which can be triggered as a lambda from our api'. Memory/running processes included. New VMs start from snapshots: child Layerfiles inherit via FROM, and 'We let you duplicate VMs to make copies of your stack and run acceptance tests in parallel' (SPLIT).

ingress_rules.quote: Private Deployments which prevents people from outside your organizations from viewing your site
ingress_rules.note: Only ports named with EXPOSE WEBSITE are published (default https://(uuid).cidemo.co or custom domain via CNAME). The docs introduction Limits table lists 'Number of private previewers' per plan (3/10/50/Custom). Debug-terminal access is gated by the 'repo.<name>.stagingterm' permission. No IP allowlists documented.

guest_firewall.note: Docs: 'Layerfiles define VMs, not containers - this means you can run anything (including docker) that you could run on a regular cloud server'; steps run as root by default (USER directive exists to run as non-root).

secret_proxy.quote: The `SECRET ENV` instruction adds values from secrets to the runner's environment.
secret_proxy.note: Built-in secrets manager injects secrets as env vars into the VM; no credential-injecting proxy.
